notes.title: Episode 4 Released!
notes.content:
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/73h4wsytoy9yfve/1%20%282%29.jpg?dl=0[/img]

Hello Pilots,

Episode 4 is released! For new players, we are excited to see what you think of ACE. For veterans, your Steam version will automatically update and you can continue your journey as long as the save slot was made at the appropriate section.

[h1]Episode 4 Highlights[/h1]
- Final chapter of ACE
- Combat reworked... no more discount DDR
- General bug fixes and stabilization

Although we have resolved all the reported bugs, you may run into the occasional one here and there as we continue to approach release. There is some voice corrections currently being processed that should update into your client automatically within a couple of days.

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
We'll be hosting a DEV stream this upcoming week/weekend with what PixelFade is up to going into the future. Stream date will be posted in an update once we finalized a date. ;)

As always, if you guys have any questions, feel free to post them on the forums. 

HAPPY READING!!

Best Regards,
PixelFade - Dishu

notes.title: ACE Academy - Episode 3 Released!
notes.content:
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/8vhk2iu3z0bwz8o/E3%20update.jpg?dl=0[/img]

Hello Pilots,

Episode 3 is officially released! For new players, we are excited to see what you think of ACE. For veterans, your Steam version will automatically update and you can continue your journey as long as the save slot was made at the appropriate section.

[h1]Episode 3 Highlights[/h1]

- More CG artwork than E1 and E2 combined
- GUI Completely Upgraded
- CG Gallery
- Music Room
- Retroactive Artwork update for GEARs in E1 and E2 CG's
- General bug fixes and stabilization

Although we have resolved all the reported bugs, you may run into the occasional one here and there as we continue to develop the project. There is some voice over currently being processed that should update into your client automatically within a couple of days.


[h1]Episode 4 Progression[/h1]

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/lv2eeli16luaxgx/E3%20update2.jpg?dl=0[/img]

Episode 4 is progressing at a solid pace! Rather than just talking about it, we'll be hosting a Developer stream to show you guys how it's going.

Stream will most likely occur on April 23rd @ 1:00PM EDT. Once the date and time are finalized, we'll post up an update! We hope to see you there. :)

As always, if you guys have any questions, feel free to post on the forums. Happy reading!

Best Regards,
PixelFade - Dishu

notes.title: ACE Academy - February Progress Update (Dev Stream: February 13th, 2016 - 10:00AM PST // 1:00PM EST // 6:00PM GMT)
notes.content:
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/qygrq5f8wuoezh4/Arena%20battle%20%28%20keyshot%29.jpg?dl=0&preview=Arena+battle+%28+keyshot%29.jpg[/img]

Hello Pilots,

We got some big announcements for you this month! Let's get started.


[h1]New GEAR CG Artist[/h1]
Please welcome Keith "Xeikth" Chan to our team! You can see his AMAZING work above and also by clicking http://xeikth.deviantart.com/. Keith will be working on all the "action" GEAR artwork for previous and future episodes. ;)


[h1]Is There a Mayu Route?[/h1]
There has always been a Mayu route! Granted it was platonic and not romantic. The deal with romantic routes is that they take a lot of resources to feel complete and her design was closely intertwined with Shou making her "romanceability" with MC difficult.

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/japbad95tk0m77c/mayu.png?dl=0[/img]

With that that being said, we evaluated community feedback and have decided to craft a Romanceable Mayu route! This required a decent overhaul to the "main" story content involving Mayu/Shou if you do/don't pursue her romantically. The specifics are for you to discover, however the draft is quite satisfying without you feeling like the "second" pick for Mayu.


[h1]More Content - Condensed Episodes[/h1]
ACE Academy was planned for 5 episodes at 30,000 word count each, resulting in a 150,000 word count story (I can do arithmetics!).

We are currently at over 124,000 word count with the first 2 episodes. Instead of taking these episodes and breaking them up into smaller chunks which would hurt pacing, we'll continue to have content rich episodes and scale back the actual number of episodes from 5 to 4. The planned story remains unchanged.

TL;DR

INSTEAD of the original 150,000 word count in 5 EPISODES, we are doing 200,000+ word count in 4 EPISODES.


[h1]Episode 3 DEV Stream[/h1]
We'll be hosting a DEV stream of episode 3 on February 13th, 2016 - 1:00PM EST. Please feel free to join us at http://www.twitch.tv/pixelfade where we will be doing a partial playthrough of Episode 3, showing the new GUI, new music, exclusive artwork previews, timeline for future episodes and more!

//// http://www.twitch.tv/pixelfade/v/44618360 ////


That's all for now. Have a great weekend!

Best Regards,

notes.title: ACE Academy - Episode 2 Released!
notes.content:
Hello,

Episode 2 of ACE Academy has been released! It should automatically update to your existing client.

[h1]What's New[/h1]
- The story continues, adding about 3 more hours of content in a single playthrough (a lot more when counting each route!)
- Introduces [b]Valerie Belle[/b], the new romanceable character
- Basic GEAR Customization

[h1]Special Considerations[/h1]
- We've made upgrades to the back-end rendering existing save files unstable. To access episode 2, you'll be playing through episode 1 (you can press tab to enter skip mode and accelerate through)
- You have 100% friendship and relationship points with all the characters for testing purposes, HOWEVER decisions will still change future options and outcomes
- Combat is scaled to be easy, it'll be balanced in the future
- There will be the occasional bugs, mismatched lines, or omitted voice. We'll be working on these as they crop up!

Thanks for your support. As always, we love to hear and incorporate player feedback so feel free to leave your thoughts in a review or on the discussions page.

Happy Reading!
